name: booster-roles
description: Personal custom roles for server boosters with sharing, moderation, and grace-period cleanup.

configFields.label: Qualifying Roles
configFields.description: Roles that grant access in addition to native server boosting

configFields.label: Anchor Role
configFields.description: New booster roles are placed directly below this role

configFields.label: Showcase Channel
configFields.description: Optional channel that announces newly created roles

configFields.label: Moderation Log
configFields.description: Optional channel for role deletion and cleanup entries

configFields.label: Max Shares
configFields.description: Maximum number of other members an owner may share with

configFields.label: Grace Period (hours)
configFields.description: How long a role is kept after its owner stops qualifying

configFields.label: Max Name Length
configFields.description: Maximum length for custom role names

endUserDataStatement: Stores booster role ownership, shared member IDs, creation time, and grace deadlines per guild, plus a per-user role index and moderator blacklist entries. Data is deleted when a role is removed or a GDPR deletion request is processed.
